faq.title: Executive Hangar Timer FAQ
faq.desc: Quick answers about the Pyro Executive Hangar, LED cycle, compboards, and contested-zone support timers.
faq.a1: It follows the Executive Hangar cycle in Pyro, showing whether the hangar is closed, opening soon, ready for compboard insertion, or in the death zone.
faq.q2: When is the Executive Hangar open?
faq.a2: The hangar becomes accessible once all five LEDs are green, and stays accessible until the LEDs finish powering down.
faq.q3: How does the 5 LED cycle work?
faq.a3: The red phase charges the LEDs one by one. Once all five are green, the access window opens; the green phase then counts the LEDs back down.
faq.q4: What are the manual support timers for?
faq.a4: They help coordinate contested-zone runs — terminals, tablets, keycards, and compboard routes around the hangar loop.
